title: Understanding L2 Regularization
text: L2 regularization, also known as Ridge Regression, adds a penalty equal to the square of the magnitude of coefficients to the loss function. This helps in reducing overfitting by discouraging overly complex models.

title: Effect on Model Bias
text: When you add L2 regularization, the model tends to become simpler. Think about how this might affect the bias of the model. Does a simpler model have more or less bias?

title: Impact on Training Set
text: What happens to the model's performance on the training set when L2 regularization is applied?
choices: The model's performance on the training set decreases
The model's performance on the training set improves
The model's performance on the training set remains the same
